title: apparmor: add signal and ptrace rules for stacked profiles
body:
With AppArmor 5.0+, child processes get stacked profiles like profile//&crun. Add //&* wildcard rules for signal and ptrace to match stacked profile peers.

This is a reproducer.
https://gist.github.com/bitoku/6fe0dd11aed0e4dad31eb0171c49279f

This will fix https://github.com/cri-o/cri-o/issues/10036 .

comments.body: Any chance of getting this PR reviewed and merged?
@TomSweeneyRedHat Probably  this PR is important for fixing CRI-O for linux kernel 7.0.0 (https://github.com/cri-o/cri-o/issues/10036)

Can you please drop the `Assisted-by: Claude Code <https://claude.com/claude-code>` trailer from the commit? We decided we do not want any AI trailer in our commits recently. ref https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/30085

I am ok with merging this otherwise
@Luap99 Will it be released for podman 5.8 as well?

We haven't backported this anywhere yet, if this is needed (I agree it seems reasonable) then we should ports this to 6.2/5.8 as well. I am not sure when we will cut the next releases there though, might take a few more weeks given we just did some.
